_note: Owner-approved area positioning. The bot may say anything written here in its own words. Avoid prices, percentages, years and drive times; those need a sourced record. Set approved to false to hide an area. An Airtable table named 'Area Guide' overrides an area with the same name.

areas.character: Hudayriyat is built around an active outdoor life: cycling and running tracks, beaches, sports and open green space, with a calm family feel.
highlights: cycling and running tracks across the island
the Surf Abu Dhabi wave pool
Marsana beachfront cafes and restaurants
beaches, bike parks and outdoor sports
a short bridge from the city centre
bestFor: people who want an active outdoor lifestyle
buyers who want a newer master community close to the city
considerations: it is a newer community that is still being built out, so services will keep growing over the coming years

areas.character: Yas is where Abu Dhabi goes out: theme parks, the Formula 1 circuit, concerts, a major mall and golf, all on one island.
highlights: Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld
Yas Marina Circuit, home of the Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix
Etihad Arena for concerts and live events
Yas Mall and the Yas Bay waterfront
Yas Links golf course
bestFor: families who want plenty to do
investors looking at holiday-home and short-stay demand
considerations: there are many launches on Yas, so it pays to compare projects carefully
it gets busy on major event weekends

areas.tagline: the island of luxury and style
areas.character: Saadiyat is Abu Dhabi's premium address: natural beaches, the Cultural District and upscale, low-rise living.
highlights: Louvre Abu Dhabi and the Saadiyat Cultural District
long natural beaches
Mamsha Al Saadiyat beachfront dining
Saadiyat Beach Golf Club
NYU Abu Dhabi and leading international schools
bestFor: buyers who want a prestige beachfront address
families who value top schools and culture
end users looking for a premium lifestyle
considerations: entry prices are among the highest in Abu Dhabi

areas.tagline: peace and quiet, with everything close by
areas.character: Ramhan offers calm, low-density island living, with Yas and Saadiyat close at hand when you want them.
highlights: a quiet, low-density island setting
a resort-style beach lifestyle
Yas and Saadiyat close by
bestFor: buyers who want privacy and calm
families looking for a quieter island home
considerations: it is an early-stage community, so day-to-day amenities will build up over time

areas.tagline: peace and quiet, with everything close by

beachfront living

areas.tagline: city living next to the financial district

highlights: next to Al Maryah Island, Abu Dhabi's financial district
Reem Mall and the Galleria close by
